title: DiscoverySettingsDocument
description: Where guests can find organisers, edited by the owner in Settings → Discovery: for each place guests browse, whether organisers on Catch (claimState claimed or verified) and organisers not on Catch yet (unclaimed or claimPending) appear; how many organisers a city needs before the homepage shows its organisers band; and whether the guest homepage offers the claim-your-page button. These rules only hide: no per-organiser switch can bring back an organiser they hide. Search-engine indexing and the app's Explore are not governed here. Absent means the defaults in functions/src/discovery/discoveryPolicy.ts.

homeOrganizersMinimum.description: The homepage shows a city's organisers band only when at least this many of its organisers may appear there.

homeClaimAction.description: Whether the guest homepage shows the claim-your-page button.

onCatch.description: Organisers whose claimState is claimed or verified appear here.

notOnCatch.description: Organisers whose claimState is unclaimed or claimPending appear here.

cityOrganizers.description: City pages and Explore's organisers tab.

plans.description: Their plans in This week and Explore.

totals.description: City and format totals: organiser counts, upcoming event counts and the format-page indexing thresholds.
